new_source_directions: Separate issuer-authored DRAM and NAND bit-shipment guidance from earlier HBM-only searches and retain both the stated range and any downside revision for the same forward period.
Search issuer earnings and newsroom material for a numeric enterprise-SSD share of NAND sales so a specific segment point value can be tested without attributing consolidated revenue to that segment.

For durable visibility, restrict the new route to issuer documents that state a 2027 memory capacity or bit-growth point or range; do not infer a quantity from sold-out, demand-secured, or investment-plan language.

suggested_queries.literal_query: SK hynix 2026 DRAM NAND bit shipment growth outlook percentage official earnings
suggested_queries.rationale: The open FORWARD_GUIDANCE role requires an issuer-authored numeric point or range for a future period. Earlier searches focused on HBM shipment growth, HBM revenue targets, or broad corporate revenue outlook; this query instead isolates the issuer's 2026 DRAM and NAND bit-shipment outlook, including any lowered range or demand downside, so a whole-company estimate or broker forecast is not substituted for product-level guidance.

suggested_queries.literal_query: SK hynix 2026 enterprise SSD revenue share NAND sales percentage official
suggested_queries.rationale: The unresolved SEGMENT_CONTRIBUTION role needs an issuer-source numeric point tied to a specific business segment. Prior searches covered HBM mix, DRAM product revenue, and a combined DRAM/NAND annual-report breakdown; this narrower route looks for an enterprise-SSD share of NAND sales or revenue, preserving the segment boundary and rejecting qualitative growth language or consolidated revenue as a substitute.

suggested_queries.literal_query: SK hynix 2027 memory production capacity bit growth percentage official investor presentation
suggested_queries.rationale: DURABLE_VISIBILITY remains open because statements that 2026 demand is secured contain no machine-readable quantity or range. This query targets a later-period issuer numeric plan for memory production capacity or bit growth, distinct from the prior 2026 HBM supply-allocation, revenue-target, and capex/cash-flow searches; only an issuer point or range explicitly referring to 2027 can qualify, while equipment capacity headlines and broker estimates remain ineligible.

unresolved_research_notes: If no issuer-authored future numeric point or range is found, FORWARD_GUIDANCE and DURABLE_VISIBILITY must remain pending; broker forecasts and qualitative demand visibility are not substitutes.
If enterprise-SSD growth is stated without a numeric share of a defined NAND revenue or sales denominator, SEGMENT_CONTRIBUTION remains unresolved.
PEER_BAND belongs to the structured peer materialization path and is not reopened through these general source queries.
